GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (21 Jan 46) GC
(SCAPIN-638)
APO 500
21 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of German Nationals in Japan.
1. Reference is made to letter C.L.O. No. 121(▲.1), dated 10 January 1946, subject as above.
2. The request of the Imperial Japanese Government for the repatriation of German nationals in Japan has been forwarded to the United States Government for such action as may be appropriate. Further information regarding this matter will be communicated to the Imperial Japanese Government when received
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A. G. D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
